feature_evidence.json: Contains feature evidence entries mapping specific UI feature requirements to associated files, components, and tests.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists short summaries of various frontend components and hooks describing their current functionality and recent improvements.
frontend/assets/.well-known/ic-domains: Empty well‑known domain file placeholder for asset directory.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML template defining metadata, icons, SEO tags, and the root mount point for the frontend app.

frontend/src/components/AdminLogin.tsx: Simple login page enabling administrators to sign in using Internet Identity to access the dashboard.

Admin view of an individual report with photos, metadata, editing options, and report deletion capabilities.
frontend/src/components/AdminReportsTabl: Admin table for viewing, editing, paginating, and managing reports with photo, location, and status handling.
frontend/src/components/AdminUserManagem: Interface for listing, adding, and removing admin users with principal validation and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/CertificateGener: Generates certificate images from report data, leader photos, and logos with customizable leader selection.
frontend/src/components/ContentManagemen: Admin tool for uploading and managing SVG logo assets with preview, validation, and history retrieval.
frontend/src/components/Dashboard.tsx: Public dashboard displaying reports with filtering, infinite loading, statistics, and volunteer-based filters.
frontend/src/components/Disclaimer.tsx: Empty placeholder component with no content.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with donation link, feedback modal, and form submission using a mutation hook.

frontend/src/components/KnowYourNeta.tsx: Component for browsing political representatives with filters, search, geolocation, and reverse‑geocoding.
frontend/src/components/LanguageDropdown: Compact language selector with dropdown behavior and outside‑click handling.
frontend/src/components/LazyImage.tsx: Lazy‑loading image component using IntersectionObserver with placeholder and load transition.
frontend/src/components/LeaderPreview.ts: Empty placeholder file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/LegalNoticeModal: Modal for generating legal notices with user input fields, signature capture, and validation logic.
frontend/src/components/MapView.tsx: Interactive map component displaying reports with a compact info card and generated static map tiles using Leaflet/OSM.
frontend/src/components/MenuDropdown.tsx: Navigation dropdown handling user roles, authentication, visitor stats, and feedback modal triggers.

frontend/src/components/PrintableComplai: Modal to generate a printable complaint including image processing, base64 conversion, and manual ZIP creation.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Empty or placeholder file with no implemented component content.

frontend/src/components/ReportCard.tsx: Displays detailed report info with images, status updates, leader selections, and various modals for actions.
frontend/src/components/ReportForm.tsx: Form for submitting new civic reports with location, category selection, file uploads, and volunteer-related logic.
frontend/src/components/ReportList.tsx: Renders a grid of all reports with loading, error, and empty states using ReportCard components.
frontend/src/components/ReportPage.tsx: Displays a single report by ID with success-state handling, loading/error views, and the ReportCard.

frontend/src/components/VolunteerRegistr: React form for volunteer registration with photo upload, validation, and submission via backend mutations.

frontend/src/contexts/LocationRefreshCon: Context enabling components to trigger and respond to location refresh events.

frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles and custom utility classes for buttons, cards, borders, and mode indicators.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React Query and Internet Identity provider before rendering the main app.
